route.title: Declarix vs Customaite: which workflow fits?
route.h1: Declarix vs Customaite: which workflow fits?
route.description: Compare preparation, review, filing responsibility and handoff. See Customaite’s published scope, Declarix’s limits and four options to evaluate.

publication: Draft build; not a release approval
method: Official vendor descriptions, source-reviewed Declarix scope, editorial fit hypotheses. Unknown is not absent. No hands-on vendor testing.

query_evidence.exact_query_brave: No results returned 2026-09-16; not Google demand evidence
query_evidence.alternatives_brave: Directories and comparison pages observed; not product evidence

declarix.title: Declarix scope review
declarix.type: First-party source review, not live acceptance
declarix.excerpt: Case-based preparation, source-linked review, configured checks and policy-driven approval. H1 remains review-only and incomplete. Direct HMRC submission is outside scope.

home.title: Customaite platform
home.excerpt: Describes a workflow from source data through declaration and archive, with compliance, automation and workflow suites.

automation.title: Customaite automation suite
automation.excerpt: Describes automated linking of invoice values and packing-list weights, extraction assistance and declarant tools.

compliance.title: Customaite compliance suite
compliance.excerpt: Describes classification assistance, intelligent data validation and trade measures.

workflow.title: Customaite workflow suite
workflow.excerpt: Describes customer correspondence, product data management and a management dashboard.

plans.title: Customaite plans
plans.excerpt: States subscription purchasing and volume-based packages. Includes customer portal in the enterprise package. No currency price was found in the reviewed page.

icustoms.title: iCustoms iCDS Import & Export
icustoms.excerpt: Describes UK CDS imports and exports, direct HMRC CDS integration, review before submission, and linked iDP document capture and iZap self-service products.

idp.title: iCustoms iDP document processing
idp.excerpt: Describes PDF/CSV/Excel intake, iCombine multi-document merging, human review and CSV/Excel/XML/custom-template exports. Authority submission uses separate customs modules; a named third-party handoff is not established.

asm.title: ASM Sequoia
asm.excerpt: Describes import, export and transit processing, customs and port-community connections, and back-office integration.

descartes.title: Descartes customs declarations
descartes.excerpt: Identifies e-Customs for the United Kingdom. Wider platform descriptions must not be assumed to apply to every UK module.

jurisdiction.country: UK H1 review profile only; incomplete
jurisdiction.evidenceType: First-party source review, not live acceptance
jurisdiction.text: The reviewed UK H1 import profile is review-only and incomplete. It must not be treated as ready for filing.

filing.country: UK H1 review profile only; incomplete
filing.evidenceType: First-party source review, not live acceptance
filing.text: Prepares and reviews proposed declaration data. Declarix does not submit directly to HMRC. The broker keeps filing responsibility.

intake.country: UK H1 review profile only; incomplete
intake.evidenceType: First-party source review, not live acceptance
intake.text: Source supports case-based mixed document intake and proposed values with source evidence. Test your formats and fields; universal coverage is not claimed.

exceptions.country: UK H1 review profile only; incomplete
exceptions.evidenceType: First-party source review, not live acceptance
exceptions.text: Request tracking, reply matching and human resolution are implemented in source. A “sent” status is not proof of email delivery. Customer self-service is not released.

approval.country: UK H1 review profile only; incomplete
approval.evidenceType: First-party source review, not live acceptance
approval.text: Assignment, recorded decisions and policy-driven second approval are implemented in source. They are not a universal junior/senior workflow.

handoff.country: UK H1 review profile only; incomplete
handoff.evidenceType: First-party source review, not live acceptance
handoff.text: Generic controlled pack and export preparation does not establish a tested Sequoia, Descartes or CargoWise connector. Named recipient acceptance is not verified.

implementation.country: UK H1 review profile only; incomplete
implementation.evidenceType: First-party source review, not live acceptance
implementation.text: Agree document scope, permissions, checks and the recipient test before a pilot. Customer deployment acceptance and support terms are not verified.

pricing.country: UK H1 review profile only; incomplete
pricing.evidenceType: First-party source review, not live acceptance
pricing.text: No current price or pilot fee is quoted here. Request written scope, inclusions and terms; do not use an old offer as a current quote.

fit.country: UK H1 review profile only; incomplete
fit.evidenceType: First-party source review, not live acceptance
fit.text: Evaluate for evidence-linked preparation and review alongside an existing filing system. Not a fit if you need direct HMRC submission or a complete, filing-ready H1 profile today.
